source: NASA/JPL Horizons API (DE441), OBSERVER ephemeris, CENTER=coord@399, times in UTC
notes: airless: APPARENT=AIRLESS (no refraction); refracted: APPARENT=REFRACTED (Horizons Earth refraction model)
az measured from North towards East; az/el are topocentric apparent; ra/dec are topocentric apparent, degrees
delta: observer range in AU; diameterArcsec: target angular diameter
rise/set/transit: flagUTC is the Horizons RTS step (first step after the event); refinedSecondsOfDay is interpolated between Horizons rows (see make_observer_fixture.py)
